nameOrigin: hard skeleton secreted by certain marine creatures
of or relating to the Sun

pokedexEntries.go: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

pokedexEntries.si: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.cr: The points on its head absorb nutrients from clean water. They cannot survive in polluted water.

pokedexEntries.ru: CORSOLA’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this POKéMON grows it back in just one night.

pokedexEntries.sa: Clusters of CORSOLA congregate in warm seas where they serve as ideal hiding places for smaller POKéMON. When the water temperature falls, this POKéMON migrates to the southern seas.

pokedexEntries.fr: In a south sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.lg: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

pokedexEntries.em: CORSOLA live in warm southern seas. If the sea becomes polluted, the beautiful coral stalks become discolored and crumble away in tatters.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

pokedexEntries.hg: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

pokedexEntries.ss: In a south-sea nation, the people live in communities that are built on groups of these Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.bw: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

pokedexEntries.x: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

pokedexEntries.y: They prefer unpolluted southern seas. Their coral branches lose their color and deteriorate in dirty water.

pokedexEntries.or: Corsola’s branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.

pokedexEntries.as: Clusters of Corsola congregate in warm seas where they serve as ideal hiding places for smaller Pokémon. When the water temperature falls, this Pokémon migrates to the southern seas.

pokedexEntries.su: Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.

pokedexEntries.mo: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokémon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.

pokedexEntries.us: The pink of Corsola that live in Alola is deep and vibrant, thanks to seas filled with nutrition.

pokedexEntries.um: In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby branches on their heads.

pokedexEntries.sw: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.

pokedexEntries.sh: These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.
